Package wellen

Class MidiIn

java.lang.Object
wellen.MidiIn
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable, Receiver
public class MidiIn extends Object implements Receiver
receives MIDI messages from a MIDI input device and forwards them to MidiInListeners.

listeners are called on the MIDI thread. a note-on message with velocity 0 is forwarded as note-off ( as defined in the MIDI 1.0 specification ).

      public MidiIn(int midi_input_device_ID)
      Parameters:

    • MidiIn

      public MidiIn(String midi_input_device)
      Parameters:
      midi_input_device - name of MIDI input device. the name does not need to match exactly: if no exact match is found the first device that starts with or contains the name is used.

      public static MidiIn create_unconnected()
      creates a MidiIn that is not connected to any device. MIDI messages can be injected with send(MidiMessage, long) e.g for testing or to forward messages from another source.
